title: Server playlist
description: Weighted rotation of rules + arena entries with optional player voting. Rules for weights, candidates, ties, repeat avoidance, minimum players and invalid entries: docs/SERVER.md#playlists.

id.description: Stable key used by repeat avoidance and the saved history (default: rules@arena).

name.description: Shown on vote cards (default: '<rules name> @ <arena name>').

arena.description: Arena id (content arenas/*.json or an installed layout package).

weight.description: Relative chance of being drawn. 0 disables the entry.

min_players.description: Fighters needed to start (default: the rules format minimum). Bots fill when allowed.

max_players.description: Maximum human fighters; extra humans spectate this match.

bots.description: Bots this entry may add (0 = humans only). Absent: the server's 'bots' setting decides.

rules_override.description: Rules keys applied on top of the preset (e.g. round_time, rounds, lives).

enabled.description: false: the next entry is drawn by weight without a vote.

candidates.description: Entries offered per vote (capped by the server's vote_candidates).

repeat_avoidance.description: The last N played entries are not offered again (relaxed if nothing else can start).
